ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This class will examine recent United States history with an emphasis on the presidential elections, public policy, popular culture, activism, and economic and social trends that helped define life in the United States after 1964. The political contributions of Shirley Chisholm, the first African American congresswoman and 1972 presidential candidate, will be highlighted to explore the development of U.S. politics elicited by the civil rights movement and subsequent struggles to influence a newly transformed body politic.
